n38984.name: Pphi2.interacting_second_moment_bound_to_freeCovariance_sum
n38984.type_full:
∀ {Nt Ns : Nat} [inst : NeZero Nt] [inst_1 : NeZero Ns] (P : InteractionPolynomial) (mass : Real) (hmass : LT.lt 0 mass)
  (Ls : Real) (hLs : LT.lt 0 Ls) (a : Real) (ha : LT.lt 0 a),
  Eq (HMul.hMul (↑Ns) a) Ls →
    ∀ (G : GaussianField.AsymLatticeField Nt Ns) (γ rem C_rem_free : Real),
      LT.lt γ 1 →
        LE.le
            (MeasureTheory.integral ((Pphi2.asymTransferSystem Nt Ns P a mass ha hmass).pathMeasure Nt) fun ψ =>
              HPow.hPow (Pphi2.asymSliceFamilyLinear ((Pphi2.asymSliceEquiv Nt Ns) G) ψ) 2)
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv 2 (HSub.hSub 1 γ))
                (Pphi2.groundSliceVarianceSum P a mass ha hmass ((Pphi2.asymSliceEquiv Nt Ns) G)))
              rem) →
          LE.le rem
              (HMul.hMul C_rem_free
                (Pphi2.freeSingleSliceCovarianceSum a mass ha hmass ((Pphi2.asymSliceEquiv Nt Ns) G))) →
            LE.le
              (MeasureTheory.integral (Pphi2.interactingLatticeMeasureAsym Nt Ns P a mass ha hmass) fun ω =>
                HPow.hPow (ω G) 2)
              (HMul.hMul
                (HAdd.hAdd
                  (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv 2 (HSub.hSub 1 γ))
                    (Pphi2.groundVarianceFreeCovarianceConstant P mass hmass Ls hLs))
                  C_rem_free)
                (Pphi2.freeSingleSliceCovarianceSum a mass ha hmass ((Pphi2.asymSliceEquiv Nt Ns) G)))

n38985.name: Pphi2.interacting_second_moment_bound_to_lattice_free_covariance
n38985.type_full:
∀ {Nt Ns : Nat} [inst : NeZero Nt] [inst_1 : NeZero Ns] (P : InteractionPolynomial) (mass : Real) (hmass : LT.lt 0 mass)
  (Ls : Real) (hLs : LT.lt 0 Ls) (a : Real) (ha : LT.lt 0 a),
  Eq (HMul.hMul (↑Ns) a) Ls →
    ∀ (G : GaussianField.AsymLatticeField Nt Ns) (γ rem C_rem_free C_free_assemble : Real),
      LT.lt γ 1 →
        LE.le
            (MeasureTheory.integral ((Pphi2.asymTransferSystem Nt Ns P a mass ha hmass).pathMeasure Nt) fun ψ =>
              HPow.hPow (Pphi2.asymSliceFamilyLinear ((Pphi2.asymSliceEquiv Nt Ns) G) ψ) 2)
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv 2 (HSub.hSub 1 γ))
                (Pphi2.groundSliceVarianceSum P a mass ha hmass ((Pphi2.asymSliceEquiv Nt Ns) G)))
              rem) →
          LE.le rem
              (HMul.hMul C_rem_free
                (Pphi2.freeSingleSliceCovarianceSum a mass ha hmass ((Pphi2.asymSliceEquiv Nt Ns) G))) →
            LE.le (Pphi2.freeSingleSliceCovarianceSum a mass ha hmass ((Pphi2.asymSliceEquiv Nt Ns) G))
                (HMul.hMul C_free_assemble
                  (MeasureTheory.integral (Pphi2.latticeGaussianMeasureAsym Nt Ns a mass ha hmass) fun ω =>
                    HPow.hPow (ω G) 2)) →
              LE.le 0
                  (HAdd.hAdd
                    (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv 2 (HSub.hSub 1 γ))
                      (Pphi2.groundVarianceFreeCovarianceConstant P mass hmass Ls hLs))
                    C_rem_free) →
                LE.le
                  (MeasureTheory.integral (Pphi2.interactingLatticeMeasureAsym Nt Ns P a mass ha hmass) fun ω =>
                    HPow.hPow (ω G) 2)
                  (HMul.hMul
                    (HMul.hMul
                      (HAdd.hAdd
                        (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv 2 (HSub.hSub 1 γ))
                          (Pphi2.groundVarianceFreeCovarianceConstant P mass hmass Ls hLs))
                        C_rem_free)
                      C_free_assemble)
                    (MeasureTheory.integral (Pphi2.latticeGaussianMeasureAsym Nt Ns a mass ha hmass) fun ω =>
                      HPow.hPow (ω G) 2))

            Eq (HMul.hMul (↑Nt) a) Lt →

                      (And
                        (∀ (M : Real) (ω : GaussianField.Configuration (GaussianField.AsymLatticeField Nt Ns)),
                          LE.le (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv M 2)) (V_S M ω))

        (norm

n39153.name: Pphi2.asymInteracting_expMoment_volume_uniform_proof
n39153.type_full:
∀ (Ls : Real) [hLs : Fact (LT.lt 0 Ls)] (P : InteractionPolynomial),
  Eq P.n 4 →
    ∀ (mass : Real) (hmass : LT.lt 0 mass),
      Exists fun K =>
        Exists fun C =>
          And (LT.lt 0 K)
            (And (LT.lt 0 C)
              (∀ (L : Real) [inst : Fact (LT.lt 0 L)] (Nt Ns : Nat) [inst_1 : NeZero Nt] [inst_2 : NeZero Ns] (a : Real)
                (ha : LT.lt 0 a),
                Eq (HMul.hMul (↑Nt) a) L →
                  Eq (HMul.hMul (↑Ns) a) Ls →
                    ∀ (f : GaussianField.AsymTorusTestFunction L Ls),
                      And
                        (MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (abs (ω f)))
                          (Pphi2.asymTorusInteractingMeasureIso L Ls Nt Ns a P mass ha hmass))
                        (LE.le
                          (MeasureTheory.integral (Pphi2.asymTorusInteractingMeasureIso L Ls Nt Ns a P mass ha hmass)
                            fun ω => Real.exp (abs (ω f)))
                          (HMul.hMul K
                            (Real.exp
                              (HMul.hMul C
                                (HAdd.hAdd
                                  (MeasureTheory.integral (Pphi2.latticeGaussianMeasureAsym Nt Ns a mass ha hmass)
                                    fun ω =>
                                    HPow.hPow (ω fun x => max (Pphi2.asymLatticeTestFnIso L Ls Nt Ns a f x) 0) 2)
                                  (MeasureTheory.integral (Pphi2.latticeGaussianMeasureAsym Nt Ns a mass ha hmass)
                                    fun ω =>
                                    HPow.hPow (ω fun x => max (Neg.neg (Pphi2.asymLatticeTestFnIso L Ls Nt Ns a f x)) 0)
                                      2))))))))

n39245.name: Pphi2.density_transfer_bound_iso
n39245.type_full:

                  (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow K (1 / 2))

    Exists fun N =>

        Exists fun hN_pos =>
          Exists fun ha_pos =>
            And (∀ (n : Nat), LE.le (a n) 1)
              (And (Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
                (And (Filter.Tendsto N Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
                  (And (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => HMul.hMul (↑(N n)) (a n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
                    (∀ (f : Pphi2.TestFunction2),

                        (fun n =>
                          MeasureTheory.integral (Pphi2.continuumMeasure 2 (N n) P (a n) mass ⋯ hmass) fun ω =>
                            Complex.exp (HMul.hMul Complex.I ↑(ω f)))
                        Filter.atTop (nhds (Pphi2.EuclideanOS.generatingFunctional μ f))))))

                  (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow K (1 / 2))
                    (HPow.hPow
                      (MeasureTheory.integral (GaussianField.latticeGaussianMeasure d N a mass ha hmass) fun ω =>
                        HPow.hPow (F ω) 2)
                      (1 / 2)))

n39408.name: Pphi2.gaussian_hypercontractivity_continuum

  (∀ (n : α) (f g : E), Eq ((B_seq n f) g) ((B_seq n g) f)) →

          And (LT.lt 0 C)
            (Exists fun s_left =>

                            (GaussianField.DyninMityaginSpace.basis j)))
                        (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul C (HPow.hPow (HAdd.hAdd 1 ↑i) s_left))
                          (HPow.hPow (HAdd.hAdd 1 ↑j) s_right)))
                  l)) →
        (∀ (i j : Nat),
            Filter.Tendsto
              (fun n => (B_seq n (GaussianField.DyninMityaginSpace.basis i)) (GaussianField.DyninMityaginSpace.basis j))
              l (nhds ((B (GaussianField.DyninMityaginSpace.basis i)) (GaussianField.DyninMityaginSpace.basis j)))) →
          ∀ (f g : E), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (B_seq n f) g) l (nhds ((B f) g))

n39575.name: Pphi2.abs_interacting_moment_le
n39575.type_full:
∀ (d N : Nat) [inst : NeZero N] (P : InteractionPolynomial) (a mass : Real) (ha : LT.lt 0 a) (hmass : LT.lt 0 mass)
  (X : GaussianField.Configuration (GaussianField.FinLatticeField d N) → Real),
  MeasureTheory.MemLp X 2 (GaussianField.latticeGaussianMeasure d N a mass ha hmass) →
    ∀ {t : Real},
      LE.le 0 t →
        LE.le t 1 →
          ∀ {K : Real},
            LE.le 1 K →
              LE.le
                  (MeasureTheory.integral (GaussianField.latticeGaussianMeasure d N a mass ha hmass) fun ω =>
                    Real.exp (Neg.neg (HMul.hMul 2 (Pphi2.interactionFunctional d N P a mass ω))))
                  K →
                LE.le
                  (abs
                    (HDiv.hDiv
                      (MeasureTheory.integral (GaussianField.latticeGaussianMeasure d N a mass ha hmass) fun ω =>
                        HMul.hMul (X ω) (Real.exp (Neg.neg (HMul.hMul t (Pphi2.interactionFunctional d N P a mass ω)))))
                      (MeasureTheory.integral (GaussianField.latticeGaussianMeasure d N a mass ha hmass) fun ω =>
                        Real.exp (Neg.neg (HMul.hMul t (Pphi2.interactionFunctional d N P a mass ω))))))
                  (HMul.hMul
                    (HPow.hPow
                      (MeasureTheory.integral (GaussianField.latticeGaussianMeasure d N a mass ha hmass) fun ω =>
                        HPow.hPow (X ω) 2)
                      (1 / 2))
                    (HPow.hPow K (1 / 2)))

n39713.name: Pphi2.ratio_l2_bound
n39713.type_full:
∀ (L : Real) [hL : Fact (LT.lt 0 L)] {N : Nat} [inst : NeZero N] (mass : Real) (hmass : LT.lt 0 mass)
  (P : InteractionPolynomial) (X : GaussianField.Configuration (GaussianField.FinLatticeField 2 N) → Real),
  MeasureTheory.MemLp X 2 (GaussianField.latticeGaussianMeasure 2 N (GaussianField.circleSpacing L N) mass ⋯ hmass) →
    ∀ (C : Real),
      LE.le
          (MeasureTheory.integral
            (GaussianField.latticeGaussianMeasure 2 N (GaussianField.circleSpacing L N) mass ⋯ hmass) fun ω =>
            HPow.hPow (X ω) 2)
          C →
        ∀ {g : Real},
          LE.le 0 g →
            LE.le g 1 →
              ∀ {K : Real},
                LE.le 1 K →
                  LE.le
                      (MeasureTheory.integral
                        (GaussianField.latticeGaussianMeasure 2 N (GaussianField.circleSpacing L N) mass ⋯ hmass)
                        fun ω =>
                        Real.exp
                          (Neg.neg
                            (HMul.hMul 2 (Pphi2.interactionFunctional 2 N P (GaussianField.circleSpacing L N) mass ω))))
                      K →
                    LE.le
                      (abs
                        (HDiv.hDiv
                          (MeasureTheory.integral
                            (GaussianField.latticeGaussianMeasure 2 N (GaussianField.circleSpacing L N) mass ⋯ hmass)
                            fun ω =>
                            HMul.hMul (X ω)
                              (Real.exp
                                (Neg.neg
                                  (HMul.hMul g
                                    (Pphi2.interactionFunctional 2 N P (GaussianField.circleSpacing L N) mass ω)))))
                          (MeasureTheory.integral
                            (GaussianField.latticeGaussianMeasure 2 N (GaussianField.circleSpacing L N) mass ⋯ hmass)
                            fun ω =>
                            Real.exp
                              (Neg.neg
                                (HMul.hMul g
                                  (Pphi2.interactionFunctional 2 N P (GaussianField.circleSpacing L N) mass ω))))))
                      (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow C (1 / 2)) (HPow.hPow K (1 / 2)))

n39716.name: Pphi2.deriv_affine_bound_neg_of_continuousOn

          LE.le 0 K →

n39873.name: Pphi2.asymCanonicalRoughError_neg_tail_of_stdGaussian_explicit_ae
n39873.type_full:
∀ {Nt Ns : Nat} [inst : NeZero Nt] [inst_1 : NeZero Ns] (a mass T : Real) (P : InteractionPolynomial) (m : Nat),
  LE.le 1 m →
    ∀
      (F :
        Subtype fun x =>
          Membership.mem
            (MeasureTheory.Lp Real 2
              (GaussianHilbert.stdGaussianFin (Fintype.card (Pphi2.AsymCanonicalJointSumIndex Nt Ns))))
            x),
      Membership.mem (GaussianHilbert.wienerChaosLE (Fintype.card (Pphi2.AsymCanonicalJointSumIndex Nt Ns)) m) F →
        ∀ (K : Real),
          LT.lt 0 K →
            LE.le (norm F) K →
              Filter.Eventually
                  (fun η =>
                    Eq (↑↑F ((Pphi2.asymCanonicalJointStdGaussianMeasurableEquiv Nt Ns) η))
                      (Pphi2.asymCanonicalRoughError Nt Ns a mass T P η))
                  (MeasureTheory.ae (Pphi2.asymCanonicalJointMeasure Nt Ns)) →
                ∀ (t : Real),
                  LT.lt 0 t →
                    LE.le
                      ((Pphi2.asymCanonicalJointMeasure Nt Ns)
                        (setOf fun η => LE.le (Pphi2.asymCanonicalRoughError Nt Ns a mass T P η) (Neg.neg t)))
                      (HMul.hMul 2
                        (ENNReal.ofReal
                          (Real.exp
                            (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg (Pphi2.ChaosTailBridge.chaosTailConstant m))
                              (HPow.hPow (HDiv.hDiv t (HMul.hMul 2 K)) (HDiv.hDiv 2 ↑m))))))

              LT.lt 0 a →
                Eq (HMul.hMul (↑Nt) a) Lt →
                  Eq (HMul.hMul (↑Ns) a) Ls →
                    ∀ (T : Real),
                      LT.lt 0 T →
                        ∀ (t : Real),
                          LT.lt 0 t →
                            LE.le
                              ((Pphi2.asymCanonicalJointMeasure Nt Ns)
                                (setOf fun η => LE.le (Pphi2.asymCanonicalRoughError Nt Ns a mass T P η) (Neg.neg t)))
                              (HMul.hMul 2
                                (ENNReal.ofReal
                                  (Real.exp
                                    (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg (Pphi2.ChaosTailBridge.chaosTailConstant P.n))
                                      (HPow.hPow
                                        (HDiv.hDiv t
                                          (HMul.hMul 2
                                            (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul K T)
                                                (HPow.hPow (HAdd.hAdd 1 (abs (Real.log T))) (HSub.hSub P.n 1))).sqrt))
                                        (HDiv.hDiv 2 ↑P.n)))))))

n40035.name: Pphi2.BridgeFromTail.bridgeAxiom_of_setup_real_generic
n40035.type_full:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace X] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (V : X → Real),
  Measurable V →
    ∀ (V_S E_R : Real → X → Real),
      (∀ (M : Real) (ω : X), Eq (V ω) (HAdd.hAdd (V_S M ω) (E_R M ω))) →
        (∀ (M : Real) (ω : X), LE.le (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv M 2)) (V_S M ω)) →
          ∀ (ψ : Real → ENNReal),
            (∀ (M : Real), LT.lt 0 M → LE.le (μ (setOf fun ω => LE.le (E_R M ω) (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv M 2)))) (ψ M)) →
              LT.lt
                  (MeasureTheory.lintegral (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioi 0)) fun M =>
                    HMul.hMul (ψ M) (ENNReal.ofReal (HMul.hMul 2 (Real.exp (HMul.hMul 2 M)))))

n40069.name: Pphi2.LatticeSetup.latticeRoughError_pure_quartic_chaos2_form

                  (HSub.hSub (Pphi2.wickConstant d N a mass) (Pphi2.smoothWickConstant d N a mass T)))

            (HMul.hMul

                (HPow.hPow a d))

    (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow a d)
      (Finset.univ.sum fun x =>
        HAdd.hAdd
          (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑P.n)
            ((Finset.range P.n).sum fun k =>
              HMul.hMul

                    (Pphi2.canonicalSmoothFieldFunction d N a mass T η x)))
                (Pphi2.wickMonomial (HSub.hSub P.n k) (Pphi2.roughWickConstant d N a mass T)
                  (Pphi2.canonicalRoughFieldFunction d N a mass T η x))))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun m =>
            HMul.hMul (P.coeff m)
              ((Finset.range ↑m).sum fun k =>
                HMul.hMul
                  (HMul.hMul (↑((↑m).choose k))
                    (Pphi2.wickMonomial k (Pphi2.smoothWickConstant d N a mass T)
                      (Pphi2.canonicalSmoothFieldFunction d N a mass T η x)))
                  (Pphi2.wickMonomial (HSub.hSub (↑m) k) (Pphi2.roughWickConstant d N a mass T)
                    (Pphi2.canonicalRoughFieldFunction d N a mass T η x))))))

            HMul.hMul (ite (LT.lt M (HMul.hMul 2 C)) 1 (ψ M)) (ENNReal.ofReal (HMul.hMul 2 (Real.exp (HMul.hMul 2 M)))))
          Top.top →

n40400.name: Pphi2.transferWeight_gaussian_decay
n40400.type_full:
∀ (Ns : Nat) [inst : NeZero Ns] (P : InteractionPolynomial) (a mass : Real),
  LT.lt 0 a →
    LT.lt 0 mass →
      Exists fun A =>
        And (LE.le 0 A)
          (∀ (ψ : Pphi2.SpatialField Ns),
            LE.le (Pphi2.transferWeight Ns P a mass ψ)
              (HMul.hMul (Real.exp (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv a 2) (HMul.hMul (↑Ns) A)))
                (Real.exp
                  (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul a (HPow.hPow mass 2)) 4))
                    (Finset.univ.sum fun x => HPow.hPow (ψ x) 2)))))

n40437.name: Pphi2.wickConstant_eq_latticeEigenvalue1d_family_average
n40437.type_full:

    (HMul.hMul (Inv.inv (HPow.hPow a d))
      (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑(Fintype.card (GaussianField.FinLatticeSites d N)))
        (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
          Inv.inv
            (HAdd.hAdd (Finset.univ.sum fun i => GaussianField.latticeEigenvalue1d N a ↑(k i)) (HPow.hPow mass 2)))))
